bias.en: Rebound · MACD crossed up, above the 30-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，站上 30 日均线

read.en: Broadcom rose 4.0% on Nov 11 to $345.22, trading $344.32–356.85. It is above the 5-day ($316.4), 10-day ($323.3) and 30-day ($339.2) and below the 100-day ($365.2) and 200-day ($367.2); all five averages are falling. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 11, below zero; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 11 ($289.77), and RSI is 53.9.

The gap higher cleared the $334.1–334.7 highs, the 30-day and the $342.3–343.3 Sep 3 and Oct 1 lows, now support; the close faded from the $356.85 high. Resistance is $350.1–356.9 (Aug 26 low, Oct 28 high, Nov 11 high), then $365.2–367.2 (100 and 200-day) and $380.8. Support is $339.2–344.3, then $332–334.7 and $323.3 (10-day). A close above $356.9 would target $365–367; below $339, $332–335.
